description: Verify the HMAC signature of a certificate's attestation (+ declared metadata, if any) without checking against any local file. Confirms authenticity and integrity of the declared data, not that a given file matches.

attestazione.description: The attestation string from the certificate.

hash.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint from the certificate.

hmac.description: The HMAC signature from the certificate.

name: verify_certificate
title: Verify a certificate's signature
